$comment: Translation status per locale and domain. English is the source locale. Every product domain is critical, and all English, Hausa, Igbo, and Yoruba catalogue entries were completed and maintainer-reviewed on 2026-09-20. The maintainer review is self-reported and is not an independent second-language review. Key parity, ICU variables, and the absence of null values are enforced by the catalogue checker.
